## Brief question 3 — strict-sha cross-run recompute: my read
Safe-conservative, and the right call for a surgical round. (a) The production ~270-cell sweep pins revisions ONCE at run start (`:349-357`, plan §10 "pin `main` at run start") and is uninterrupted — the guard never fires against a moved HEAD within one invocation. (b) Mid-sweep crash + restart: the restart re-pins at restart time. If HEAD is unchanged, done cells skip (meta-validated) — checkpoint-per-cell preserved, which is the case the guard exists for. If HEAD moved during the crash window (plausible on this busy shared repo), ALL done cells recompute: ~270 × 4–6 s CPU SVD ≈ 18–27 min plus re-downloads (note `--evict-every 5` cache eviction means downloads are NOT all cache hits — but this is bandwidth + CPU only, no GPU, bounded by the original run's own cost). The failure direction is strictly redundant-compute, never stale-reuse and never data loss — checkpoint-per-cell still protects the artifacts themselves. This does NOT meet the bar for a persisted deferred-feature concern (no production crash, no silent degradation); the implementer documented the tradeoff honestly in (b)/(d) with a content-hash softening named as a possible later follow-up. Acceptable as-is.

## Interpretation (epm:interpretation v1 body)

### Raw-output spot check (5 random rows)

This is a `kind: analysis` task — no model completions exist anywhere in the run (every read is deterministic linear algebra over stored weight matrices and forward-pass centroids), so the spot check samples 5 random result rows (seed=42) from the pooled eval JSONs (`key_match.json` cells + `write_match.json` cells + `rotation.json` primary cells) instead of raw generations:

1. `[key_match] i474/loc_A1_ep5` (source = the plain-assistant transformation): band |cos| mean 0.0601, best selectivity margin 0.0000, key_present = False — at the null, consistent with the headline key miss.
2. `[key_match] dial527/librarian__police_officer__B_only__seed137` (source = police_officer): band |cos| mean 0.0496, best margin −0.0017, key_present = False — at the null.
3. `[key_match] i474/pos_B1_ep3` (source = framing transformation): band |cos| mean 0.0815, best margin 0.0000, key_present = False.
4. `[key_match] i474/pos_A2_ep5`: band |cos| mean 0.0602, best margin 0.0000, key_present = False.
5. `[key_match] i474/loc_D5_ep1` (source = register-rewrite transformation): band |cos| mean 0.0844, best margin +0.0373, key_present = True — one of the secondary-line "distinctive context" whispers (D5 hits 8/8 cells in MLP-input space), consistent with the in-body characterization of weak above-null hits concentrated on idiosyncratic contexts.

No fishiness: no silent zeros (every cell has 28 per-layer rows), no degenerate nulls on the key side, values match the aggregates I computed independently from the raw JSONs. One structural N/A class is disclosed in-body: 3 of 9 fact-line own-bank cells are `N/A — source not in the 24-persona bank` (recorded as status strings, not zeros).

### Verdicts (kill-criteria routing per plan §14)

**Decomposition prediction — HOLDS for the marker recipe, recipe-specific.** Dial residual-write stacks carry 59–73% top-1 energy (uniform floor 0.021–0.0625); concentration rises with re-measured dose (top-1 write energy Spearman +0.88, p < 0.001, N = 30 clean single-source cells; stacked-attention effective rank −0.76, p < 0.001) — the weights-level echo of #538's activation-level collapse. Saturated endpoint near literal rank-1 (down_proj 0.92). EM no-source control and hot-lr fact line are diffuse (top-1 energy 0.08–0.27, effective rank ≈ parameterization bound). No decomposition kill; but decomposition is a property of the marker training regime, not LoRA generally.

**Key-identity prediction — KILLED on the headline lines.** §14 key kill is met: across the marker dial AND the saturated endpoint, at every layer and stack, under both γ-transformed and raw reads, cos(key, source context) sits inside the wrong-context null band (per-line band-mean medians 0.048/0.053/0.060 vs shuffled-pairing null p50 0.045/0.051/0.056; 3 of 216 dial read-variants pass the loose presence criterion with margins ≤ 0.003 ≈ p95 false-positive rate; saturated endpoint 0 of 9). Decisive instrument-free corroboration: cross-seed key |cos| = 0.015 median (n = 69 pairs) while cross-seed WRITE |cos| = 0.927 — the key is not a reproducible function of the training data at all, so it cannot be the context vector or any fixed contrast of context vectors. Degeneracy checks pass (σ1/σ2 ≈ 1.5; joint-cell top-2 subspace span capture ≈ 0.0007 — not a rotating-vector-in-stable-subspace artifact). Instrument validated: split-half centroid stability ≥ 0.97 in band. Residual caveat (caps confidence): centroids are last-prompt-token; the marker loss trains the post-response slot; a key matching some other position's context state is unprobed (plan §15 carry-over: "a key HIT is informative, a key MISS ambiguous" — the conservative kill was scoped knowing this). Secondary-line whisper honestly reported: distinctive contexts (pirate/comedian/villain, 8/8 cells in MLP-input space at |cos| ≈ 0.08–0.12; fact-line idiosyncratic persona rank-1 at L14 in 2 of 3 readable seeds) — real but two orders of magnitude short of identity.

**Write-identity prediction — INSTRUMENT-LIMITED (routed per §14, not a kill).** The EM positive control fails: pooled write vs the matched-seed shared shift direction |cos| = 0.11–0.25 (bar: 0.5), where the activation-level shared direction is established (its own cross-seed stability 0.65–0.90). Dial cells: |cos| ≈ 0.155 flat in dose, 0 of 72 above per-cell panel null p95, source's own shift ranks median 16 of 19 (the trained context's shift is among the LEAST aligned — echoes #521's activation-level signature). Null non-degenerate but narrow (p5–p95 ≈ 0.12–0.18) because the 19-persona shift matrices are themselves ~41% top-1. Verdict: the σ-weighted linear pooled-write read cannot recover cumulative propagated shifts even when the target direction provably exists → P0 qualification, not falsification.

**Dose-rotation prediction — NOT SUPPORTED; formal kill blocked on a technicality.** Primary: Spearman(Δcos, dose) = −0.45 (N = 30; cluster-bootstrap interval −0.66 to −0.32; 0/6 clusters positive; joint −0.60; all-54 −0.52) — wrong sign. Decomposition: cos_raw rises with dose (+0.64) but its per-line medians track the shuffled-pairing null medians EXACTLY (0.047/0.052/0.058 vs 0.045/0.051/0.056) — pure common mode, nothing source-specific; the placebo contrast falls with the same slope (−0.68) as the registered Δcos. Contrast axis non-degenerate (residual norm 0.22 of source norm) → not an inconclusive-geometry case. The third kill condition (no loc-vs-pos separation on the epoch ladder) is technically unmet: paired slope difference +0.0003/epoch (bootstrap interval +0.0001 to +0.0005, 12/16 sources positive) — statistically positive but ~100× smaller than the cosine levels (~0.05) and spreads (±0.01) involved, with the contrastive arm sitting slightly FURTHER from the contrast direction than positives-only at every epoch. Honest read: no rotation worth the name; and with the key at the null (above), the rotation statistic was tracking the orientation of noise.

### Adversarial check of the orchestrator's quick read

- Key/write/rotation/seed-stability numbers: CONFIRMED against the raw JSONs (write med is 0.155, slightly above the quoted ≈0.14; rotation Δcos median −0.0359 ✓; seed key 0.015 / write 0.927 ✓).
- The flagged uniform-NEGATIVE `all_panel_cos` signs: NOT a bug. Singular-vector sign is arbitrary (plan's registered convention: |cos| primary); the uniform sign across a panel reflects the shift matrix's shared component (top-1 frac ≈ 0.41), not a sign-flip artifact.
- The flagged i541 own-bank read: weak whisper only (rank 1–3 at L14, |cos| ≈ 0.07, 3 of 6 readable cells; 3 N/A); does not change the key-identity verdict.
- The flagged epoch-ladder-vs-dial tension: both consistent with "no real rotation" once the dial trend is decomposed into common mode + placebo.
- shift_matrix_top1_frac 0.41 vs #538: at the cell level the dose trend in that ACTIVATION-side statistic is not significant here (Spearman 0.20, p = 0.29, N = 30); the dose trend that IS strong is the WEIGHTS-side write concentration (+0.88). Reported accordingly — the body does not claim an activation-side dose trend.

### Confidence

MODERATE (title tag). The key-identity kill is the headline and stands on two independent legs (null-calibrated context match + instrument-free seed instability) with a validated instrument; what caps it below HIGH is the token-position scope caveat (last-prompt-token centroids vs post-response-slot training — a key matching a different position's context state is unprobed), the instrument-limited write read (one of P0's two identity claims stays unresolved), and the single-seed epoch ladder. The decomposition and constancy positives are clean but secondary.

### Follow-ups

- Top-k key-subspace read: project each source context vector onto the stored top-8 right-singular subspace per layer (vectors already in the 209 per-cell `.npz` on the HF data repo + the Phase-B bank) and test subspace-energy vs the wrong-context bank (cost_class: free-analysis, headline_affecting: yes) — a subspace hit would soften the "key is noise" headline to "key is distributed below top-1"; both inputs verified resolvable (`huggingface_hub.list_repo_files` listing of `issue604_adapter_svd/analysis_tensors/` at write time; local copies in the worktree).

- Propagated-write read: push the pooled weight-space write through the remaining layers with forward passes and compare at the measured-shift layer (cost_class: needs-gpu, headline_affecting: yes) — could resolve the instrument-limited write identity in either direction.
- Query-side router read: score keys in q/k space against base-model query states (Wang et al. router relaxation) (cost_class: needs-gpu, headline_affecting: no — would refine the mechanism story, not the kill).

### 1. Post-response-slot context-vector re-read — Diagnostic (corrected re-measurement)

**Parent:** #604
**question_relation:** same
**followup_label:** post-response-slot-key
**Goal:** Test prediction P0 of the rank-1 leakage model at the weights level: the top singular vectors of trained ΔW are the key (source context vector v_c') and the write (realized activation delta), and under contrastive training the key moves from raw v_c' toward a source-minus-negatives contrast direction as dose grows.
**Hypothesis:** The key kill's single biggest validity cap is the token-position proxy: keys were scored against LAST-PROMPT-TOKEN centroids while the marker loss trains the POST-RESPONSE slot. If P0's key identity is real at the trained position, re-extracting the 42-context bank at the post-response slot (final token of the base model's own greedy response — the state whose next-token prediction the marker loss shapes) will put the matched source above the wrong-context and shuffled-pairing nulls in the top-1 and top-8 reads. Honest prior: the cross-seed top-1 arbitrariness (median 0.015) already argues against ANY deterministic top-1 key at any position, so the live part of the rescue is the top-8 subspace read at the right slot; the likely outcome is a second null.

**Hypothesis:** The write-identity leg is unresolved because the σ-weighted linear pool failed its own EM positive control — a layer-20 measured shift is the cumulative propagated effect of edits at every layer below, which no linear pool of per-layer write vectors can represent. ### 3. Query-key routing selectivity read — Exploration (new mechanism)

**Parent:** #604
**question_relation:** substantially-different
